text_html:
Uploading a few videos this morning all about a proof of concept I have put together for Bass OS.

This first video is of our AIO (all-in-one) concept for Bass OS Android 14. Booting into tablet UI after initial install.

https://youtu.be/8YskNGxwQjg?si=v_mOCkCY7ch4m8xD

link_preview.title: POC: Bass OS - AIO - Android 14: Tablet mode
link_preview.description_html:
This is a proof of concept build of the upcoming All-In-One type build of Bass OS.

This video is demoing booting into the Tablet UI after initial install.
